_what: DRW-1 ledger: every mass the drawing draws in the master-suite zone, reconciled against the BUILT scene. Consumed by pipeline/scripts/sheet_recon.py (--recon/--gate) and printed by plan_status.py at session open.
_law: Rows never leave this file (ratchet). A wrong row is refuted in its note, never deleted.
The machine owns `match`/`verdict`/`warning` and recomputes them on every run from the CURRENT scene dump — a match that disappears un-matches itself.
`identity` and `gap` are HUMAN-SIGNED and the machine never invents them (two-layer law of the plan-extraction lane). A gap without reason+decider is refused; `pending` is refused by name.
Frustum UNKNOWN blocks the gate. Could-not-run exits 2 and must never print like clear.
Exit bar (owner เคาะ 2026-08-11): UNRESOLVED = 0 among rows in (or possibly in) the DELIV-001 camera frustum.
